d.ko:
An award-winning 4v4 third-person class shooter with more personality than sense! The mobile classic millions grew up with is now on PC.

Choose from 11 unique classes, mix hundreds of thousands of loadout combinations, and battle it out online or with friends across 16 wacky maps!
